text.p: The average yield at the latest auction of three-month discount treasury bills fell to 30.19 percent from 35.83 percent at the last sale on January 23, a central bank statement said on Wednesday.
The results of Tuesday's auction, compared to the last issue of three-month discount T-bills, were as follows:
Amount sold 5.00 million UAH 14.94 million UAH
Actual amount raised 4.65 million UAH 13.71 million UAH
The central bank sold 50,000 T-bills, the bank's statement said.
The date of the next auction of three-month discount T-bills is unfixed.
